items.exampleEn: This book is popular amongst young office workers.
items.exampleZh: 這本書在年輕上班族之間很受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: Some people work better alone; conversely, others need a team.
items.exampleZh: 有些人獨自工作效率較好；相反地，有些人需要團隊。

items.exampleEn: He saved his work every few minutes lest the computer crash.
items.exampleZh: 他每隔幾分鐘就存一次檔，以免電腦當機。

items.exampleEn: Admittedly, the plan is expensive, but it will save us time.
items.exampleZh: 誠然，這個計畫很貴，但它能幫我們節省時間。

items.exampleEn: Our new manager is a law unto himself.
items.exampleZh: 我們的新經理我行我素，自有一套規矩。

items.exampleEn: Lastly, I want to thank everyone for coming.
items.exampleZh: 最後，我要感謝大家來參加。

items.exampleEn: Thirdly, the new system is easier to learn.
items.exampleZh: 第三，新系統比較容易學。

items.sentenceEn: Admittedly, the hotel was far from the city center, but the rooms were lovely.
items.sentenceZh: 誠然，那家飯店離市中心很遠，但房間很漂亮。

items.audioEn: Please check the numbers twice lest we send the wrong price to the client.
items.audioZh: 請把數字檢查兩次，以免我們把錯的價格寄給客戶。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要把數字檢查兩次？
options: To avoid sending a wrong price
To get a better price from the client

items.sentenceEn: That old printer seems to be a law unto itself.
items.sentenceZh: 那台舊印表機好像自有一套規矩，想怎樣就怎樣。

items.sentenceEn: When prices go up, sales go down; conversely, lower prices bring more sales.
items.sentenceZh: 價格上漲時銷量就下滑；反過來說，價格降低會帶來更多銷量。

items.stemEn: Firstly, it is cheap. Secondly, it is fast. ____, it is easy to carry.
items.stemZh: 第一，它很便宜。第二，它很快。第三，它很好攜帶。

items.stemEn: Please speak quietly ____ you wake the baby.
items.stemZh: 請小聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

items.passageEn: At the end-of-year party, our manager, Helen, gave a short speech. "This year was admittedly difficult," she began. "But amongst all the problems, we found three things to be proud of. Firstly, we kept every customer. Secondly, we opened a new office in Kaohsiung. Thirdly, nobody left the team. Some companies grew bigger but became less friendly; conversely, we stayed small and became even closer. I wrote my notes on my hand lest I forget anything, but my handwriting is impossible to read!" Everyone laughed. "Lastly," she said, "thank you all for your hard work."
items.passageZh: 在尾牙上，我們的經理 Helen 做了簡短的致詞。她開場說：「不可否認，今年很辛苦。但在這些問題當中，我們找到三件值得驕傲的事。第一，我們留住了每一位客戶。第二，我們在高雄開了新辦公室。第三，沒有人離開團隊。有些公司規模變大，卻變得不那麼親切；相反地，我們維持小規模，彼此卻更親近。我把筆記寫在手上，以免忘記任何事，可是我的字跡根本沒人看得懂！」大家都笑了。她說：「最後，謝謝大家這一年的辛勞。」

questions.questionZh: Helen 提到的第二件值得驕傲的事是什麼？
Helen 為什麼把筆記寫在手上？

items.promptZh: 不可否認，這份工作很辛苦，但我學到很多。
referenceEn: Admittedly, this job is hard, but I have learned a lot.
Admittedly, the work is tiring, but I've learned a great deal.
rubricZh: admittedly 用來先承認一個不利的事實，常放句首加逗號
後半句用 but 等表示轉折；「學到很多」可寫 learn a lot、learn a great deal 等，現在完成式或過去式都可以

items.promptZh: 這家店平日很安靜；相反地，週末總是擠滿了人。
referenceEn: This shop is quiet on weekdays; conversely, it is always crowded on weekends.
The shop is quiet during the week. Conversely, it is always full of people on weekends.
rubricZh: conversely 帶出相反的情況，可放分號後或新句句首（例如 ; conversely,、. Conversely, 等）
「平日」可寫，例如 on weekdays、during the week 等
「擠滿了人」可寫，例如 crowded、full of people、packed 等；always 位置不扣分
